tree.heading: Eligibility of Navajo Tribe
tree.text: The Navajo Tribe shall not be eligible to participate under the provisions of this subchapter.

children.text: The Secretary shall not provide any funds to any institution which denies admission to any Indian student because such individual is not a member of a specific Indian tribe, or which denies admission to any Indian student because such individual is a member of a specific tribe.
The Secretary shall take steps to recover any unexpended and unobligated funds provided under this subchapter held by an institution determined to be in violation of paragraph (1).
